Our car scratch remover can also help remove light hard water spots along with paint transfers off of clear coats of cars Follow this Application Method- Wavex Scratch Remover for Car should be poured onto a clean microfiber cloth, apply on scratched area and gently rub with finger pressure to clean the scratched area.
